changes.title: UNFINISHED: known options for dictionary fields, parts only
changes.detail:
Batch 61, saved unfinished so the work is not lost. Nothing in the interface uses it yet, so behaviour for people is unchanged.

In this commit - Server: an admin-only websocket command, tts/engine/options, that returns a text-to-speech engine's supported, common and default options. It compiles and has a written test. It has NOT been run against a real server. - Frontend: a model for "known options" of a dictionary field (merge by source, value kinds, keys used elsewhere in the home), a loader for the server command, and a catalogue holding only the five tts.speak option keys confirmed in the server source. No unit tests yet.

Not done - The visual dictionary editor does not show known options: no chips, no specific controls, no strings. The action, field and language are not passed to the editor. - Notification data keys were left out on purpose: they are read by the companion app and could not be confirmed in this repository.

Checks: type check at baseline (the two known gallery errors); the Python files compile. The full test suite was not run for this commit.
